The '''Mandalorian Blademaster''' was a title held by members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] people.

{{Mando-stub}}

==Overview==
This rank was an ancient position within the ancient Mandalorian military hierarchy which was given to those individuals who showed exceptional competence in the use of handheld melee weapons such as swords or daggers.
